query: 社区参与战略 社区参与战略 衡量企业与运营所在地社区进行沟通、资源共建、诉求反馈及长期投入的框架体系。重点考察社区议题识别的科学性、利益相关方参与深度及公益/共建项目的效果评估机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的社区参与战略（包含中长期目标）；定期开展社区需求调查（议题识别）；建立了双向、常态化的社区沟通与反馈机制；具备量化的社会影响力评估（如 SROI 评估或第三方成效审计）。 • 1分（合格）：有明确的公益或社区投入重点（如乡村振兴、教育支持），建立了基础的社区联系路径，有项目进展报告，但缺乏深度的需求调查、闭环反馈机制或系统的效果评估。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策或战略披露，或仅有零散、无计划的捐赠行为描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：社区参与战略覆盖 >80% 的主要运营地区（如工厂所在地、核心门店网点）或重点公益预算项目。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅在总部所在地开展活动，而忽略了外地生产基地或分支机构的社区关系，或未说明覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 社区参与战略 社区需求调查 利益相关方沟通 社区投入 共建项目 社会投资回报 社区反馈机制 SROI community engagement strategy community needs assessment stakeholder dialogue community investment shared value SROI community feedback mechanism 是否有系统的社区参与战略、中长期目标或明确投入重点？ 是否定期开展社区需求调查或议题识别？ 双向沟通、诉求受理与反馈闭环是什么？ 有哪些共建/公益项目、投入金额及进展？ 是否开展SROI、第三方成效审计或其他量化社会影响评估？ 战略覆盖哪些主要运营地区、工厂所在地、门店网点或重点项目，覆盖比例是多少？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '社区参与战略'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有系统的社区参与战略、中长期目标或明确投入重点？ 是否定期开展社区需求调查或议题识别？ 双向沟通、诉求受理与反馈闭环是什么？ 有哪些共建/公益项目、投入金额及进展？ 是否开展SROI、第三方成效审计或其他量化社会影响评估？ 战略覆盖哪些主要运营地区、工厂所在地、门店网点或重点项目，覆盖比例是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有零散无计划捐赠；仅有社会影响评估技术方法而无社区共建；仅有员工志愿服务时长无战略；仅有政府公关活动；区分：社区参与战略强调与运营地社区的沟通共建与长期投入；社会影响评估是项目社会后果识别缓释方法；实质性评估是ESG议题优先级，不是社区战略。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group has hired a consulting firm to conduct stakeholder engagement in the previous reporting year, using a quantitative approach to identify the material topics for the Group. Stakeholder engagement is conducted by questionnaire surveys, collecting opinions from a total of 70 external stakeholders, which are the opinions of the customers. With the assistance of the consulting firm, the senior management had selected 26 economic, environmental and social issues for participants to rate the issues anonymously in the questionnaire (1 is least important, 5 is the most important). Based on the scoring of these issues, the Group has identified a total of 13 important issues, which are disclosed in detail in the report to respond to the stakeholders.

results.text: D&G prioritises domestic and local suppliers to support the local economy and reduce the environmental footprint generated in transporting materials. D&G added a sustainable development procurement charter into its 'Supplier Management Measures' in 2019, and in 2020, it increased the proportion of supplier management assessment's environment, occupational health and safety ('EHS') to 10%. To ensure our suppliers share our sustainability vision, we regularly interview them to make sure their services meet our expectations for sustainable development. In terms of logistics of merchandise, D&G is devoted to gradually extending the coverage of our customer base, and improving the domestic and international freight logistics systems. The Group also regularly evaluates the performance of logistics companies that are currently cooperating with and bidding, including their overall loading capabilities and integrated service levels. During the reporting year, the Group has already added 14 suppliers. Among a total of 154 suppliers, only 4 of them were overseas suppliers.

6 Sustainable Value Chain

[Content]
D&G prioritises domestic and local suppliers to support the local economy and reduce the environmental footprint generated in transporting materials. D&G added a sustainable development procurement charter into its 'Supplier Management Measures' in 2019, and in 2020, it increased the proportion of supplier management assessment's environment, occupational health and safety ('EHS') to 10%. To ensure our suppliers share our sustainability vision, we regularly interview them to make sure their services meet our expectations for sustainable development. In terms of logistics of merchandise, D&G is devoted to gradually extending the coverage of our customer base, and improving the domestic and international freight logistics systems. The Group also regularly evaluates the performance of logistics companies that are currently cooperating with and bidding, including their overall loading capabilities and integrated service levels. During the reporting year, the Group has already added 14 suppliers. Among a total of 154 suppliers, only 4 of them were overseas suppliers.

results.text: At the beginning of April, the corporate culture team drafted the planning book for this competition. The competition was promoted through the posters on the bulletin board, the announcement of the large group of D&G Homes, and the active mobilisation of each center on 14th April. 'The Most Beautiful Spring' photo contest kicked off on 15th April. We have received 158 photos from four Centers, 56 staff participated in this competition. The review process is divided into three parts: the primary selection based on the theme of 'spring', the members of the corporate culture team conduct the first round of screening; the second round consists of 9 professional reviewers, three aspects including the theme connotation, creative idea, visual effect are considered; in the third round, joint voting was conducted, each member have 5 votes. In this competition, we have 1 first prize, 3 second prizes, 6 third prizes and 5 special prizes.

The review process is divided into three parts: the primary selection based on the theme of 'spring', the members of the corporate culture team conduct the first round of screening; the second round consists of 9 professional reviewers, three aspects including the theme connotation, creative idea, visual effect are considered; in the third round, joint voting was conducted, each member have 5 votes. In this competition, we have 1 first prize, 3 second prizes, 6 third prizes and 5 special prizes.
